effect.name: Water Reflection
effect.description: Flips the image, ripples it and fades it out with depth. Put a copy of your scenery below the waterline, apply this, and it reflects.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Water Colour
parameter.description: Colour the reflection is tinted toward. Default is DMG 48,98,48.

parameter.name: Ripple Size
parameter.description: How far the ripples push pixels sideways, in texels.

parameter.name: Ripple Count
parameter.description: How many ripples fit down the reflection.

parameter.name: Speed
parameter.description: How fast the ripples travel when Time is animated.

parameter.name: Time
parameter.description: Animate this to make the water move.

parameter.name: Tint
parameter.description: How strongly the water colour stains the reflection.

parameter.name: Depth Fade
parameter.description: How much the reflection fades out toward the bottom, which is where it is furthest from the surface.

parameter.name: Flip
parameter.description: On mirrors the image vertically, which is what you want when the source is the scenery above. Off leaves it upright.
